units.source_text: 西阵纺织业工会采取了前所未有的果断措施，决定自十一月十二日至十九日共八天，停止开动所有织机。

en.t: The Nishijin textile industry union took an unprecedentedly decisive measure, deciding to stop all looms for eight days, from November 12 to November 19.

units.source_text: 十二日和十九日是星期天，实际上是停工六天。

en.t: Since the 12th and the 19th were Sundays, the shutdown was actually for six working days.
